items.context: Kya aap extension chahenge kuch dino ka?
items.text: thoda intezar karo
Mera naam Rahul hai aur main Delhi se bol raha hun
Main 5000 rupay ka payment delay karna chahta hun thoda
Kya aap ek hafte ka extension de sakte hain please
Mujhe payment ko do baar mein karna padega Kyunki abhi paise nahi hain
Main Bangalore mein rehta hun aur mera address MG road hai
Kal tak payment kar dunga lekin thoda time do
Account number 123456 se mera payment confirm karna tha

items.context: Aapko kitna extension chahiye payment ke liye?
items.text: Haan ji thoda din aur chahiye

items.context: Kya aap apna payment split karwana chahenge?
items.text: Main paise ko do part mein jama kara doonga

items.context: Kitna amount delay kar rahe hain aap?
items.text: Main chaar hazaar rupe late kar doonga

items.context: Kripya apna poora naam aur location batayein
items.text: Mera naam Sita hai aur main Kolkata se hoon

items.context: Kya hum aapko kuch aur din de sakte hain?
items.text: Aap thoda aur time den to achha rahega
Mera naam Anil Kumar hai main Jaipur se bol raha hun mera account number 789654123 hai aur main thoda extension chahta hun payment ke liye kyunki abhi tak salary nahi aayi hai
Namaste mera naam Priya Sharma hai main Lucknow mein rehti hun aur mujhe apna pending payment do hisso mein karna hai kya aap madad karenge
Main Rohit Singh hoon aur main Chennai se bol raha hun mera due amount abhi clear karne mein thoda samay lagega please mujhe ek hafta aur time de dijiye payment ke liye

items.context: Kya aap payment ko portions mein karna chahenge?
items.text: Main apne ghar par Delhi mein rehta hun aur mujhe payment ko split karna hoga do hisso mein kyunki mere paas abhi poora paisa nahi hai

items.context: Kab tak aap payment kar payenge?
items.text: Mujhe thoda aur waqt chahiye kyunki mera paisa kal tak hi mil payega main Jaipur se hun aur mera account number 345612789 hai

items.context: Aapko kitni der tak extension chahiye?
items.text: Mujhe thoda extension chahiye payment karne ke liye kyunki main apni job ke transfer mein busy tha isliye payment late hoga mujhe ek hafta aur chahiye

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:
Domain: collections
Intent: ask_extension - asks for more time or to split the payment
Language: Hindi-English code-mixed, entirely in Latin script (e.g. 'mera account se paise kat gaye but transfer nahi hua').
Style for this batch: with names, addresses or places; some phrased as questions

Write exactly 24 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'haan ji', 'kal tak', 'theek hai'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 7 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 5 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 3 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
